production_boundary_proofs.proof: Original iOS entry starts real allModules; strict Json(ignoreUnknownKeys=false,isLenient=false,encodeDefaults=true); singleton FileBackedSnapshotStore uses singleton IosSnapshotFileSystem. L08 storage checks the runtime types, not substituted in-memory bindings.

Mutex around all operations; serializer work on Default; filesystem owns its IO context. SerializationException and SnapshotProtectionException => CorruptedData, other Exception => IoError(snapshot_io). Cancellation rethrows; fatal Errors are not caught. Strict UTF8; metadata reads only session/game fields; bounded safe path component.

Application Support/Parlor/snapshots is created with Complete attributes and directory backup exclusion. Atomic encrypted writes request Complete and verify file exclusion. Every legacy access excludes legacy directory before migration/corrupt handling; current encrypted data has precedence. Retained legacy is deleted only after current decrypt or successfully installed migration, or explicit delete; cancellation/failure retains it.

Corrupt-record migration exceptions remain discoverable for Retry/Discard; CancellationException rethrows. Legacy backup exclusion runs outside per-record failure isolation, so unavailable protection is not silently accepted as a healthy empty inventory.

Encryption calls keychain.loadOrCreate before inner catch; Keychain IllegalStateException there maps to store IO, not necessarily CorruptedData. Decrypt wraps most key-read failures as SnapshotProtectionException so CorruptedData is not a unique authentication diagnostic. Header/name/IV/ciphertext are HMAC-bound, checked before AES plaintext publication. Exact v1/IV16 and ciphertext alignment guards; key arrays wiped.

NotFound alone returns null; success requires nonnull exact CFData64. Other status throws sanitized failure. Creation uses random64, accepts duplicate only to reread durable winner, never replaces an existing key, wipes candidate and releases CF ownership. Generic password, fixed app alias, non-synchronizing, AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly.

8 MiB plaintext cap, protected cap+1024, bounded maximum+1 native read with finally-close; successful decrypted oversize buffer wiped before rejection; empty AES input passes null pointer. L08 observer has a smaller synthetic-only read ceiling.

Home retains per-record unreadable tiles with warning and propagates source failure; max8 inspected entries(+1 overflow). Router validates session identity and registered game. Failures route to explicit Retry/Discard; no automatic deletion. Generation and originating route gate stale asynchronous callbacks.

All seven owned aliases must independently return NotFound and be physically absent. Unavailable/corrupt is intentionally not treated as empty; subtype is not emitted in the closed failure record.
Reducer-built legal deterministic game state, game codec and expected envelope. Failure here precedes the following store read/write and cannot by itself be attributed to Foundation/Keychain.

Current diagnostic source now covers only actual store.save and Success assertion. The closed FAIL receipt does not distinguish a returned DataError from another caught Exception. Native05 used an older broader stage; do not retrofit this narrowed meaning onto that old receipt.
Actual store.load and Success assertion only. Failure may be NotFound, authentication/decode corruption, sanitized IO, or another caught exception; no status detail is emitted.

Full GameSnapshot value equality including payload.contentEquals, not ByteArray identity. Payload is wiped in finally. On restart expected state is independently rebuilt; equality failure needs codec/determinism/state-source isolation.
Exact canonical owned paths, directory/regular-file type, and file existence. Observer does not create or repair the protected path.

Fresh NSURL resource dictionary, NSNumber and boolValue readback. Observer passes a null error pointer; production setter separately checks NSError and readback. Failure may be getter/type/value; never assert actual physical backup behavior from metadata alone.
Both NSFileProtectionKey and NSFileProtectionComplete must be nonnull. This is distinct from directory/file readback.

attributesOfItemAtPath(..., null)?.get(key) == Complete. Each assertion still conflates nil dictionary/error, absent key and different value. A FAIL identifies the exact failed assertion, not the OS capability or production root cause. No getter repair/retry is made.

Bounded ciphertext read at 256 KiB+128 then PARSNAP prefix check. The header alone is not authentication proof. Earlier store load is a separate actual decrypt/codec check. No measured evidence here establishes an oversized fixture.

Actual game-owned recovery, registered Home destination, authenticated inventory, corrupt-neighbor isolation and retained dual-copy identity. Resolve each concrete assertion before classification; expected CorruptedData is a successful negative witness, not a repaired valid save.

Only explicit token-owned synthetic seeding creates the legacy directory. Dual-copy setup uses a second legal envelope and mutates one verified HMAC byte in-place; never reads real user saves or repairs production metadata.

Actual public Home/Retry/Discard taps and attached production controller/writer, bounded waits, explicit terminal deletion and next-process absence. Driver actions are synthetic; not a complete UI game playthrough or abrupt-power-loss proof.
Enclosing stage retained for compatibility. Nested stages restore the enclosing stage only on success, never in finally, so they cannot conceal their own failure.
